title: Kaya Session Volume Goal Adherence by Gym Area
dataSources: Kaya sessions (`kaya:session`), MoonBoard sessions (`moonboard:session`), Tension Board sessions (`tensionboard:session`), 8a.nu sends (`eighta:send`), hangboard protocols (`hangboard:protocol`).
app: Kaya app sessions, MoonBoard and Tension Board logs, 8a.nu send history, and hangboard protocol trackers streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=kaya:session
| stats avg(problems_completed) as actual count as sessions by gym_area
| eval pct_of_goal=round(100*actual/12.0,1), goal_label="12"
| sort pct_of_goal
description: Compares average problems completed with a simple target for each gym area, showing where kaya session volume is meeting plan and where it is lagging.
value: Splitting target adherence by gym area shows which contexts are helping you hit the plan and which ones need adjustment.
implementation: Set the target value in the query to match your routine, then review low-adherence gym area values before the next session block.
visualization: Table of gym area values with average problems completed and percent of goal.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which gym area settings help you hit your target for kaya session volume and which ones fall short.
